Alex: Heads up — saw ~7% drop in prefix cache hit for /api/generate after the toolcall param-reorder PR went to prod sometime last night. Weird spike in cold misses.
Morgan: Ugh. Any quick diffs or repro?
Alex: here's the perf dashboard (quick): https://perf.redwood/internal/dashboards/tx1234 — hit rate before/after attached. Short repro locally: run `make perf-repro` then curl the loadscript.
Tina: Did the PR change the JSON ordering for `tool_call`? We currently include the whole tool payload in the cache key verbatim, so key ordering would matter.
Javier: I pulled the merged diff — it changed sensor -> params ordering in the tool args and also moved `extras` to the end. Example:
```json
{"tool": "lookup", "args": {"q": "x","k": 3}}
```
vs
```json
{"tool": "lookup", "args": {"k": 3, "q": "x"}}
```
Those would hash differently today.
Alex: Yeah this lines up. Kernel selection/batching stats unchanged, so runtime perf looks fine — this is cache-key churn.
Morgan: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) revert the param order change (hotfix) or 2) canonicalize tool payloads in cache-key generation (longer fix). Revert buys time.
Tina: Short fix: normalize tool arg keys + sort arrays of primitives for now. Also pin tokenizer+metadata version in the key to avoid other drift. Pseudocode: 
```python
def canonical_key(obj):
  if isinstance(obj, dict):
    return '{' + ','.join(f"{k}:{canonical_key(obj[k])}" for k in sorted(obj)) + '}'
  if isinstance(obj, list):
    return '[' + ','.join(canonical_key(x) for x in obj) + ']'
  return str(obj)
```
Then use canonical_key(tool_payload) when building the cache fingerprint.
Javier: Agree. Also we should add a unit test asserting that semantically equivalent toolcalls (reordered keys) produce same cache fingerprint.
Alex: I'll open the hotfix to canonicalize (small change in runtime) and create a follow-up for full validation + tokenizer-pin. If hotfix looks risky we can revert the PR — what's the rollout status?
deploy-bot: deploy v2026.04.11-tool-reorder -> prod at 2026-04-11T02:12:03Z (owner: Morgan) :rocket:
Morgan: Rollout is at 40% canary, bumped to 80% at 02:30. I can stop/rollback if needed.
Alex: Please stop the rollout to 100% for now. Morgan can you pause?
Morgan: Pausing now, rolling back the PR to canary state and pinning instances back.
Tina: I'll sketch the canonicalization patch and the unit tests. Also adding an integration test that simulates kernel-level batching to ensure no regressions in batch keys.
Javier: Add a quick perf run once canonicalization is applied — we need to confirm no perf regression from the extra serialization step. Maybe use caching of the canonicalized string to avoid re-serializing in hot paths.
Alex: Good call. Cache the canonical string on the request object (short TTL). Post-mortem note: treat toolcall payloads as canonical order in our keying docs.
Morgan: Thanks. I'll coordinate the rollback and leave the canary at 10% while we validate the patch. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks everyone. Will update thread with PR link and perf numbers after tests.
Morgan: PRs: #4128 (hotfix canonicalize), #4131 (unit + integ tests).
Alex: Quick ask — can eng-sre add an alert for >3% sudden drop in prefix cache hit over a 15m window? That would've caught this earlier.
deploy-bot: alert rule created: cache.prefix_hitrate_drop_15m by Morgan.
Morgan: Added.
Tina: ETA for hotfix review? 30-45m.
Alex: Great.
